pages.text: Cold, damp weather brings coughs, most of all in leaf-bare. $(br2)$(l)Whitecough$() makes a cat weak, but it is rarely deadly. Left untreated, it can turn into $(l)greencough$(), which is far worse.
pages.title: Whitecough and Greencough

pages.text: Catmint is the best cure for both coughs, and the only one for greencough. It is so tasty you must be careful not to eat it all yourself!
pages.title: Catmint

pages.text: Juniper berries help with whitecough and with chills. They are not as tasty as catmint, but they work.
pages.title: Juniper
